mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, instance_id, form_data, content_text, field_snapshot_json, layout_snapshot_json, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted FROM oa_instance_data WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE oa_instance_data SET form_data = CAST(#{formData} AS JSON), content_text = #{contentText}, field_snapshot_json = #{fieldSnapshotJson}, layout_snapshot_json = #{layoutSnapshotJson}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE oa_instance_data SET deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND deleted = 0
